# My Piano (https://my-piano.evostackr.in/)

> My Piano is a free, interactive 88-key virtual piano web application developed by Evostackr. It delivers studio-grade acoustic grand piano sounds across 7 full octaves with zero latency via the Web Audio API. It operates purely client-side without installation, plugins, or user registration.

## Website Overview & Canonical Details
- **Website URL**: https://my-piano.evostackr.in/
- **Creator / Developer**: Evostackr (https://evostackr.in/)
- **Support Contact**: support@evostackr.in
- **License**: MIT (Free to use, educational & recreational)
- **Application Category**: Interactive Virtual Musical Instrument / Audio Web Application

## Core Musical Capabilities & Features
- **Total Keys**: 84 playable physical keys spanning 7 octaves (49 white keys: A1 through G7; 35 black keys: A#1 through G#7).
- **Audio Sample Quality**: 88 individual acoustic grand piano Vorbis (.ogg) audio samples recorded from a concert grand piano.
- **Polyphonic Audio Engine**: Full polyphony via HTML5 Web Audio API; users can strike multiple notes simultaneously, play chords, triads, arpeggios, and trills without dropped voices or audio clipping.
- **Interactive Mini-Piano Seekbar**: Top navigation strip styled with an authentic 88-key miniature piano image (`scrollbgm.jpg`) and draggable viewport window (`thumb.jpg`), featuring real-time bidirectional synchronization with the main piano keyboard.
- **Visual Touch Feedback**: Active keys illuminate with a vibrant cyan contact glow (`#80ffe5`) for a minimum of 100 milliseconds or for the duration of the touch/hold.
- **Octave Navigation**: Quick-jump pills for Octaves 1 through 7, plus `[` and `]` keyboard shortcuts.
- **Audio & Viewport Controls**: Master volume slider with instant mute toggle, fullscreen performance mode matching native mobile orientation, and keyboard shortcut badge toggles.
- **Privacy & Performance**: 100% client-side execution; zero user tracking, zero third-party profiling cookies, and zero personal data collection.

## QWERTY Computer Keyboard Mapping (Middle C / Octave 4)
- **White Keys (Natural Notes)**:
  - C4: `A`
  - D4: `S`
  - E4: `D`
  - F4: `F`
  - G4: `G`
  - A4: `H`
  - B4: `J`
  - C5: `K`
  - D5: `L`
  - E5: `;`
  - F5: `'`
- **Black Keys (Accidentals / Sharps)**:
  - C#4: `W`
  - D#4: `E`
  - F#4: `T`
  - G#4: `Y`
  - A#4: `U`
  - C#5: `O`
  - D#5: `P`
- **Octave Shifting**:
  - Shift one octave down: `[` (or Alt + Left Arrow)
  - Shift one octave up: `]` (or Alt + Right Arrow)

## Step-by-Step Playing Guide (HowTo)
1. **Initialize Sound**: Click or tap any key on the piano to start the browser Web Audio context.
2. **Play Notes**: Strike keys using a mouse click, touchscreen tap, or computer keyboard keys (A-J home row).
3. **Play Chords**: Press multiple computer keys simultaneously or use multi-finger touch on tablets and smartphones.
4. **Navigate Octaves**: Click the Octave pills (Octave 1 to 7) or drag the mini-piano seekbar at the top to explore the full 7-octave acoustic range.
5. **Adjust Volume**: Use the slider in the top header or toggle fullscreen mode for an immersive performance.

## Verified Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Is My Piano completely free?** Yes, it is 100% free with no registration, subscriptions, fees, or paywalls.
- **Can I play piano using my computer keyboard?** Yes, desktop keyboard mapping is enabled by default on the home row (A-J for white keys, W-U for black keys).
- **Does it work on mobile phones and tablets?** Yes, it is fully responsive on iOS (Safari) and Android (Chrome) with multi-touch glissando and chord capabilities.
- **How do I find Middle C?** Middle C is labeled C4 on the piano keyboard, located in Octave 4 directly to the left of the two-black-key cluster.
- **Who built My Piano?** My Piano was created and is actively maintained by Evostackr. Support email: support@evostackr.in.
